content_fields.name: evidence_slot_identity
content_fields.note: Immutable identity of the slot this observation fills. It is part of the content digest, never only mutable row metadata.

content_fields.name: evidence_kind
content_fields.note: What sort of observation this is (for example ci_result, review_verdict).

content_fields.name: provider_immutable_identity
content_fields.note: The provider's immutable identity, never a display name.

content_fields.name: tuple
content_fields.note: The exact (repository, base, head) tuple, where the slot is tuple-bound.

content_fields.name: logical_check_key
content_fields.note: The stable name of the check within the provider, so a renamed display label cannot silently become a different check.

content_fields.name: provider_source_event_identity
content_fields.note: The provider's own identity for the event this observation reports.

content_fields.name: source_generation
content_fields.note: The trusted, monotonic generation or revision the provider attaches to its own results. This, not time, decides which observation is current.

content_fields.name: source_principal
content_fields.note: The authenticated principal that delivered it.

content_fields.name: observed_at
content_fields.note: Recorded for audit. Never used to decide which observation is current, and never a tie-break.

ordering.rule: The current observation for a slot is the one with the greatest trusted source generation. observed_at and database ingestion order are audit facts and are never used to order provider truth, and never as a tie-break.

conflict.same_generation_same_digest: IDEMPOTENT_DUPLICATE — the second delivery changes nothing.
conflict.same_generation_different_digest: CONFLICTED — the whole slot fails closed. No observation in a conflicted slot may be used as gate evidence until the conflict is resolved by a new, greater generation from the provider.
conflict.no_maximal_generation: CONFLICTED — if no single greatest generation exists, the slot fails closed.

provider_admission: A provider that offers no trusted monotonic ordering contract over its own results may not be used as gate evidence at all.
snapshot: The snapshot is still computed over the sorted, newline-joined immutable content digests of the current observations.
redemption_triple: the evidence snapshot recomputed from current observations equals the bound evidence_snapshot_ref
those observations satisfy the evidence policy currently in force
the tuple they are bound to still equals the effect tuple
